value.rationale: The motivating primary paper explicitly approximates integer-degree hitting times by a continuous Fokker–Planck model to study threshold-dependent curvature. The finite exact expression replaces that approximation and proves ordinary discrete curvature remains strictly positive for all parameters, while specifying factorially growing hard-target times. This corrects a scientifically motivated qualitative boundary and provides reusable exact benchmark values, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
